## ⛔ This project does not accept pull requests

**Pull requests are not merged. This one will be closed.**

MejiroPDF is dual-licensed (AGPL-3.0-or-later + commercial), which requires the
copyright to stay with a single author. Third-party code — even a few lines —
would mean every commercial license needs that contributor's permission or a
signed CLA. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full reasoning.

**Nothing is being read into your patch.** The policy applies to every pull
request regardless of its content.

## What to do instead

Open an [issue](../../issues) describing the problem. Bug reports are welcome
and are used to improve the library — the fix is then written by the author.

A report is easiest to act on with:

- the MejiroPDF version (`MejiroPDF\Version::VERSION`) and your PHP version;
- a minimal script that reproduces it;
- expected vs. actual behaviour;
- the error code (e.g. `MP-VAL-1001`) and the exception's `context`, if any.

**Security vulnerabilities:** do not open a public issue — email
<support@2bo-velocity.com>.
